product_family: Obsidian is a local-first knowledge management and note-taking application with optional paid services: Sync (multi-device synchronization with E2E encryption), Publish (static website publishing), and Canvas (visual workspace). Core application is free for personal use.

certifications.name: ISO 27001
certifications.proof_quote: Obsidian lacks ISO 27001, NIST, or comparable certifications but offers third-party security audits

certifications.name: GDPR
certifications.proof_quote: Privacy policy references Canadian Personal Information Protection and Electronic Documents Act but does not explicitly address GDPR compliance

certifications.name: Third-Party Security Audits
certifications.proof_quote: Cure53 conducted penetration testing and source code review in October 2024; Trail of Bits conducted Sync security assessment in December 2025. Both audits covered API, server, and cryptography. All identified issues have been remediated.

privacy.ai_training_note: No evidence of AI training on customer data. Obsidian's design philosophy is local-first; user data is stored on user devices and not sent to Obsidian servers unless user opts into Sync or Publish services.
privacy.data_region: Mixed: local (on user device) for core app; Sync/Publish services may be processed and stored outside Canada

security.name: Local Data Storage
security.value: Core application stores all data locally on user device by default. No account required, no telemetry collected.

security.name: Encryption in Transit
security.value: HTTPS/TLS for all connections (Sync, Publish, account management)

security.name: Encryption at Rest
security.value: Sync service uses AES-256 end-to-end encryption. Publish data is encrypted.

security.name: Sync Infrastructure
security.value: All data including file names is end-to-end encrypted in Sync service. If subscription expires, data retained for 1 month; upon cancellation, deleted immediately.

security.name: Plugin/Theme Security
security.value: Community plugins and themes in official directory undergo automated scanning for vulnerabilities, code quality, and malware. Popular and flagged items receive manual review.

security.name: Account Protection
security.value: 2FA available for Obsidian accounts. No SSO support. Users of Sync/Publish must confirm 2FA on first login if enabled.

security.name: Third-Party Processors
security.value: Payment processors: Stripe, WeChat Pay, Alipay, PayPal. Service providers may be located outside Canada.

products.name: Obsidian (Desktop & Mobile)
products.data_scope: Local-first; user controls all data on device
products.notes: Free for personal use. Commercial use requires per-user license ($50/year). No sign-up required; no telemetry.

products.name: Obsidian Sync
products.data_scope: Encrypted multi-device sync; E2E encrypted on servers
products.notes: Optional paid service ($4-$8/month). Data encrypted end-to-end. Audited by Cure53 (Oct 2024) and Trail of Bits (Dec 2025).

products.name: Obsidian Publish
products.data_scope: Hosted on Obsidian servers; content published as static site
products.notes: Optional paid service ($8-$16/month). Allows users to publish notes as web-accessible digital gardens.

products.name: Obsidian Canvas
products.data_scope: Stored locally; optionally synced via Sync service
products.notes: Infinite visual space for brainstorming and diagramming within local notes.

compare.pricing_model: Freemium: free personal use; optional paid services for Sync ($4-$8/mo), Publish ($8-$16/mo), and commercial use licenses ($50/year)
compare.data_residency: Local storage on user device (default); Sync/Publish services may be processed outside Canada
top_certs: Third-party security audits (Cure53, Trail of Bits)

flags: No formal certifications (SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA, PCI DSS) - vendor relies on third-party audits instead
Privacy policy does not explicitly address GDPR compliance; vendor is Canadian but handles international data
Data residency for Sync/Publish not specified; only note that service providers may be outside Canada
No Data Processing Agreement (DPA) mentioned; may be issue for GDPR-regulated organizations
No SSO support for base application; requires email-based account management for Sync/Publish
